scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Ah, today seems like
a perfect day for forging.
I just feel like going behind
a beautiful waterfall, getting
some high quality materials,
and just hammering things.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
啊，今天真適合鍛造。
真想找條美麗的瀑布，躲到後面，備上優質材料，痛痛快快地掄起錘子。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
I see that you've
transcended since the
last time we've met. Oh...
You must have forgotten
everything I've taught you.
Well, let me teach you again~
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
上回見面之後，你已經轉生了啊。
哦...我教的東西一定都忘了吧。
沒關係，再教一次就是了~

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Actually, let me jog your
memory with this counterfeit
zeny that we made the last time. Do you remember how to perform
Dubious Salesmanship? You
should be able to use it now...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
拿上回一起做的假Zeny，幫你回憶一下吧。
想起詭計的商術怎麼用了？
現在應該會了...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Hi again~
How has the smithing
been coming along? Anyway,
it was really nice of you to
drop by and talk to me~
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
又見面了~
鍛造得怎麼樣了？
總之，很高興你能過來和我聊天~

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
It can get a little boring
teaching Dubious Salesmanship
to Blacksmiths and Master Smiths, but somebody from our guild has
to do this job. Anyway, farewell and be safe in your travels, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
教鐵匠和神工匠詭計的商術，難免有點無聊，可公會總得有人做這份工作。
那麼，再見，路上注意安全哦。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Hello, I'm Akkie from
the Blacksmith Guild. I'm
here to teach this new skill
to all interested Blacksmiths
and Master Smiths, but it looks
like your Job Level is too low...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
你好，我是鐵匠公會的阿基，負責向想學的鐵匠和神工匠傳授新技能。
不過，你的職業等級好像還不夠...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Hello, {0},
I'm here on behalf of the
Blacksmith Guild to teach you
a new skill. However, your Job
Level is a little low right now
for me to teach you anything...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
你好，{0}。
我代表鐵匠公會，負責傳授一項新技能。
不過，你現在的職業等級還低，暫時沒法教你...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
But practice smithing
a little bit more, and
once you qualify, I'll be
sure to teach you my skill!
Goodbye and good luck~
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
再多練練鍛造吧，夠資格了，我一定教你！
再見，祝你順利~

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
I'm sorry, {0},
But you'll qualify for the
skill I teach after you
raise your Job Level.
In the meantime, keep
training, alright?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
抱歉，{0}，職業等級再提高些，才能學我這招。
先繼續修行，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Hello there~
Isn't it such a
wonderful day today?
It's perfect for hunting!
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
你好呀~
今天天氣真好，不是嗎？
非常適合打獵！

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Um, let me introduce myself.
I'm Akkie, a representative of
the Blacksmith Guild that has
been dispatched to teach the
Dubious Salesmanship skill to
Blacksmiths and Master Smiths.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
嗯，先自我介紹吧。
我是阿基，鐵匠公會派我來，向鐵匠和神工匠傳授詭計的商術。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
This additional class
skill enables you to reduce
the amount of zeny spent to
cast Mammonite by 10%. This
Passive skill might come in
handy for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
這項職業專屬的附加技能，能讓金錢攻擊少消耗10%的Zeny。
{0}，這被動技能說不定很適合你。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Although I'm new at
this, would you like
for me to teach you
Dubious Salesmanship?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
雖然我教人的經驗還不多...你願意跟我學詭計的商術嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure. I'll try learning this
new skill. Who knows?
It might be really useful.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好啊，試著學學吧。
說不定真能派上大用場。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh, that's great!
You won't regret this!
Now, let me explain how
this skill works. Um, now
where did I put that-- Ah.
Let me read these guidelines.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
太好了！
你不會後悔的！
我先講講原理。
嗯，放哪兒了——啊，先看看這份教學指南。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Using Dubious Salesmanship,
we can reduce Mammonite's
zeny cost by 10% by forging
fake zeny to use in the skill.
Since it's against enemies,
we can let the forgery slide.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
詭計的商術，就是鍛造假Zeny，拿來施展金錢攻擊，將Zeny的消耗降低10%。
反正是拿來對付敵人的，造點假幣就不計較了。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Now, I need you to bring
some materials so that I can
demonstrate the forging of
counterfeit zeny. Please
bring me 1 Steel, 5 Coal,
1 Iron Hammer and... and...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
先帶些材料來，我好示範鍛造假Zeny。
需要鋼1個、煤5個、鋼鐵錘子1把，還有...還有...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Um, would you give
me a minute to look
up the information?
I'm sorry about th-this...
^333333(I thought I highlighted this
in the manual. Where is it?)^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
嗯，能等我一下，讓我查查嗎？
對、對不起...
^333333（我記得在手冊裡劃過重點，究竟在哪兒？）^000000

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh! Oh, I found it!
L-let me start all
over again. Uh...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
啊！找到了！
我、我從頭再說一次，呃...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
^0000FF1 Steel^000000,
^0000FF5 Coal^000000,
^0000FF1 Iron Hammer^000000,
^0000FF500 zeny^000000 and
^0000FF1 Detrimindexta^000000. Would
you bring those, please?

[{0}]
Sure, sure.
But are you actually
able to teach me this
skill? I mean...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，好。
不過，你真的會教嗎？
我是說...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh no, I knew this was going to
happen! I mean, um, it should
be fine! I've been working here
for 3 months a-and-- Just bring
me the materials and I'll prove
you can learn it e-easily!
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
糟了，就知道會這樣！
不，我是說，嗯，肯定沒問題！
我在這裡做了3個月了，而、而且——材料帶來，我就證明給你看，學起來很、很容易！

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
You've gotta trust me!
You won't be disappointed,
I promise! This skill is sooo
useful! So just bring me those
materials soon, alright?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
相信我嘛！
保證不讓你失望，這招可好用了！
快把材料帶來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Wh-what?! But why not?
A-am I not good enough
for you? Please, I promise
to do my best to teach you.
Besides, I've got to reach
my quota for the guild...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
什、什麼？！為什麼不學？
是、是我不夠好嗎？
拜託，我保證認真教。
再說，公會的指標還等著我完成呢...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh, you came back~
Now let me see if you
brought everything we
need to make counterfeit
zeny so that I can teach
you Dubious Salesmanship.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
你回來啦~
我看看，鍛造假Zeny的材料齊了嗎？
齊了就能教你詭計的商術。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Hmm, you're still
missing a few things.
Let me tell you what you
need to bring me once again
so that we can start training
you in the skill right away.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
嗯，還差幾樣。
我再說一遍要帶什麼，找齊就能開始學習了。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
^0000FF1 Steel^000000,
^0000FF5 Coal^000000,
^0000FF1 Iron Hammer^000000,
^0000FF500 zeny^000000 and
^0000FF1 Detrimindexta^000000.
Don't forget, okay?

[Akkie]
Hmm, you have all the
forging materials, but
I still need 500 zeny.
We need that zeny to copy,
or we won't be able to make
convincing counterfeit money.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
嗯，鍛造材料都齊了，但還差500 Zeny。
要仿造出逼真的假幣，得先有真錢做樣本。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh, you came back~
Now let me see if you
brought everything we
need to make counterfeit
zeny so that I can teach
you Dubious Salesmanship.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
你回來啦~
我看看，鍛造假Zeny的材料齊了嗎？
齊了就能教你詭計的商術。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Good job, it looks like
you've got what we need.
Alright, now please wait
while I get these materials
ready for forging, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
不錯，東西齊了。
稍等，我先把鍛造材料準備好。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
A-ah! You came
back sooner than
I thought. Um, gee.
Hmm. How should
I tell you this?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
啊！你回來得比我想的還快。
呃，這個...該怎麼說呢？

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
I'm so sorry! I messed
something up while I was
making a counterfeit sample!
I'm so sorry, please d-don't
report me to the Blacksmith
Guild! Give me one more chance!
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
對不起！
做假幣樣本時，我弄壞了些東西！
請、請別向鐵匠公會投訴，再給我一次機會吧！

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
I promise that next time
I won't mess up! All I need
is 1 Steel and 3 more Coals!
Please d-don't be angry with
me, it was just an accident!
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
保證下次不會搞砸了！
再給我鋼1個、煤3個就夠。
別、別生氣嘛，只是個意外！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, okay...
Are you sure that's
all you need me to get?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，好吧...
確定只要這些？

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Yes, yes! Oh, thank
you for being so generous!
Just bring me ^FF00001 Steel^000000 and
^FF00003 Coals^000000 and we'll try again!
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
對，對！
謝謝你這麼寬宏大量！
帶來^FF00001個鋼^000000和^FF00003個煤^000000，我們再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
All I need you to do
is bring me 1 Steel and
3 Coals. Then I should
be able to teach you the
Dubious Salesmanship skill~
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
再帶來鋼1個、煤3個，我應該就能教你詭計的商術了~

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh, thank you so
much for bringing these
materials. Alright, I'll try
really hard to succeed
this time. Just give me
a minute to prepare...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
謝謝你又送來材料。
這回一定努力成功，給我點時間準備...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no...
Did... Did you...
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟了...
你、你該不會...又出什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
*Sniff* I b-broke the
Iron Hammer you gave
me! I c-can't finish forging
this without one! Waaah~
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
*吸吸鼻子*我、我把你給的鋼鐵錘子弄壞了！
沒錘子就鍛造不下去了！
哇~哇~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(I guess I should
really bring her a new
^FF0000Iron Hammer^333333, or else
I'll never learn this skill!)^000000

[Akkie]
Waah~! I can't believe
I broke the Iron Hammer!
Would you please bring me
another one so that I can
finish this counterfeit zeny and teach you Dubious Salesmanship?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
Waah~!哇~！居然把鋼鐵錘子弄壞了！
能再帶一把來嗎？
做好假Zeny，才能教你詭計的商術。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
^333333*Sniff*^000000 Did you
r-really bring this
Iron Hammer for me?
Th-thank you for being so
patient with my screwups...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
^333333*吸吸鼻子*^000000真、真的是給我的鋼鐵錘子？
我老出岔子，你還這麼有耐心，謝謝你...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Okay, would you
give me a moment?
I'm going to try
one more time.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
再等我一下，好嗎？
我再試一回。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh, you're back!
Yaaaay, I finally did it!
I finished making a sample
of counterfeit zeny and even
tested it with Mammonite!
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
回來啦！
太好了，我總算成功了！
假Zeny樣本做好了，還用金錢攻擊試過了！

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh, before you learn my
skill, I'm supposed to tell you
that my colleague, Goodman,
can teach you another additional skill known as Greed. So you
may want to look for him later.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
哦，教你之前，還有件事。
我同事古德曼能教另一項附加技能，叫貪婪。
之後不妨去找他。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Okay, now the first part to
learning Dubious Salesmanship
is making this fake zeny. Watch
this... Isn't it easy? Of course, you can only use this in battle to
reduce Mammonite's zeny cost...
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
學詭計的商術，先從製作假Zeny開始。
看這樣...是不是很簡單？
當然，只能拿來戰鬥，降低金錢攻擊的Zeny消耗...

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Also, 90% of the cost of
Mammonite has to be real
zeny or the skill will begin
to lose effectiveness. Well,
that's all for the lesson. Now you can use Dubious Salesmanship!
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
另外，金錢攻擊消耗的Zeny，九成還得是真錢，不然威力就會減弱。
好了，教完了，你已經會用詭計的商術了！

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Thanks once again for
putting up with my mistakes,
I know it must have been really
annoying. Anyway, I hope this
skill is really useful for you.
Drop again sometime, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
謝謝你一直包容我的失誤，肯定給你添了不少麻煩。
希望這招真能幫上你。
有空再來聊聊，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Oh, have you spoken with
Goodman in Einbroch yet?
He's the representative of
the Blacksmith Guild that
teaches the Greed skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
去艾音布羅克找過古德曼了嗎？
他也是鐵匠公會的代表，負責傳授貪婪。

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
If you're serious about
smithing goods, the Greed
skill might be very convenient.
Though, I have to say that the
skill's name is a little... Um.
Hmm... It sounds pretty bad~
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
認真鑽研鍛造的人，學會貪婪會方便不少。
不過，這招的名字...嗯，怎麼說呢，聽著不太好~

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
Hi again~
How has the smithing
been coming along? Anyway,
it was really nice of you to
drop by and talk to me~
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
又見面了~
鍛造得怎麼樣了？
總之，很高興你能過來和我聊天~

scripts.text:
[Akkie]
It can get a little boring
teaching Dubious Salesmanship
to Blacksmiths, Master Smiths and Mechanics, but somebody from our guild has
to do this job. Anyway, farewell and be safe in your travels, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿基]
教鐵匠、神工匠和機匠詭計的商術，難免有點無聊，可公會總得有人做這份工作。
那麼，再見，路上注意安全哦。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
I feel like exploring
the mountains to look for
rare and interesting items
that I can use in forging.
For me, that's the greatest
pleasure of being a Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
真想到山裡走走，找些稀奇有趣、能用於鍛造的材料。
做鐵匠，最大的樂趣就在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Ah, I see that you have
transcended. It gladdens me
to see Blacksmiths become
Master Smiths for the sake
of improving their craft.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
看來你已轉生了。
為了精進技藝，從鐵匠成為神工匠，真叫人高興。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Hm? You've forgotten the
Greed skill? You should
remember how to use it now:
just looking at me should
jog the memories you require
to use this skill once again~
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
嗯？忘了貪婪怎麼用？
看看我，應該就能想起來了，再試試~

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
How is your forging
technique coming along?
When the craft frustrates you,
traveling will offer a good
opportunity to relax, think,
and collect materials.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
鍛造手藝練得怎麼樣？
遇上瓶頸，不妨出去走走，既能放鬆、思考，也能收集材料。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Hey. I'm a Blacksmith
skill master sent from the
Blacksmith Guild. Everyone
calls me Goodman. You're
a Blackmith, aren't you?
Pffft, rhetorical question.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
嘿，我是鐵匠公會派來的技能導師，大家叫我古德曼。
你是鐵匠吧？
噗，這不明知故問嘛。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Hey. I'm a Blacksmith
skill master sent from the
Blacksmith Guild. Everyone
calls me Goodman. You're
a Master Smith, aren't you?
Pffft, rhetorical question.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
嘿，我是鐵匠公會派來的技能導師，大家叫我古德曼。
你是神工匠吧？
噗，這不明知故問嘛。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Good news. I'm in charge of
teaching the skill, developed
by the Blacksmith and Merchant
Guilds, called ^FF0000Greed^000000. It's your
choice whether you learn it,
but I recommend that you do.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
好訊息，我負責傳授鐵匠公會與商人公會共同開發的技能，^FF0000貪婪^000000。
學不學隨你，不過我勸你學。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
If you want, I can start
teaching you the Greed
skill right now. So what
do you say, kid?
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
願意的話，現在就能教你貪婪。
小子，怎麼說？

scripts.text: Sounds good!
scripts.translation: 聽起來不錯

scripts.text: Maybe later~
scripts.translation: 以後再說~

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Heh! Good choice. Now,
the Greed skill automatically
picks up all items in a 5*5
cell area around the caster.
It's handy for picking up clumps of goods from looting monsters.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
嘿，選得好！
貪婪能自動拾取自身周圍5×5格範圍內的所有物品。
碰上愛撿東西的魔物，打倒後掉了一地，用它收拾就方便多了。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
First thing's first. I need to
test you and see if you qualify
to learn this skill. Go fill your Inventory with any items until
it's so full, you can't put an
item of 500 Weight in it.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
先考考你，看看夠不夠資格。
往物品欄裡裝東西，直到剩餘負重連一件重量為500的物品都容納不下。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
When you finish that
task, come back and
talk to me. Alright
then, good luck~
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
做到了就回來找我。
好，祝你順利~

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
I see. It's good to be
busy with other things,
but remember that time is 
a commodity, and you should
always spend it doing the most
worthwhile stuff. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
明白，忙別的也好。
可記住，時間也是商品，該花在最值得的事上，懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Hm. You've come back
too early. And you didn't
complete the objective that
I set for you. Listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
嗯，回來太早，還沒完成考驗呢。
聽好了。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Go fill your Inventory
with any items until it
becomes too full to place
an item of 500 weight into it.
When you finish this task,
come back and report to me.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
往物品欄裡裝東西，直到剩餘負重連一件重量為500的物品都容納不下。
做到了，再回來彙報。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Back already, eh?
Alright, let me check
the things you're carrying.
Let's see, Inventory, Inventory...
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
回來了？
來，看看你帶了什麼。
物品欄，物品欄...

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Good work: you pass.
Do you realize now that the
time and experience spent in
gathering these items is worth
more than their prices in zeny?
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
不錯，通過了。
現在明白了嗎？
收集物品花費的時間、積累的經驗，比它們能賣多少Zeny更有價值。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
I believe that Blacksmiths
should first and foremost be
artisans. Being rich and famous
is merely a side effect of that.
Honorable Blacksmiths know value is in the craftsmanship...
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
鐵匠首先應當是匠人，財富和名聲只是隨之而來的。
真正有操守的鐵匠，懂得價值在於手藝...

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
Now, if you don't place too
much importance on an item's
worth in terms of zeny, you'll
be able to let go of them much
more easily. Watch me do this.
See? Now you can do it too.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
別太執著於物品能值多少Zeny，才更容易放開手。
看我這樣做...看見了嗎？
你也會了。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
The skill you learned is
called Greed, but I hope
you use it in a manner that
is different than its name.
Don't forget that, and I hope
you craft true masterpieces.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
這招雖叫貪婪，可我希望你別照著名字去用。
記住，願你鍛造出真正的傑作。

scripts.text:
[Goodman]
How have you been using
the Greed skill? Hopefully,
it has been convenient in
your efforts to forge goods
of greater quality for all
of your comrades.
scripts.translation:
[古德曼]
貪婪用得如何？
希望它能讓你更方便地收集材料，為同伴們打造更優質的裝備。
